## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type

- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] No private code, secrets, customer data, or internal endpoint details
- [ ] Public API and compatibility implications documented
- [ ] Unit/integration tests added or not needed (explain)
- [ ] `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` executed
- [ ] `main` remains stable; target branch is `dev` unless this is an approved release/hotfix
